Schema

Every DSDS schema definition, on one page: the base document, every entry kind, every section kind, and every shared common shape.

base

object · schema/base.schema.yaml

A DSDS document. Acts as the container for all content. Can be optionally extended or split across other DSDS documents.

The version of this spec the document follows. The name of the design system this document describes. Every entry this document owns, listed directly.
Min items: 1 An optional hint for editor tools, like autocomplete or validate-on-save. Reusable content that is not itself a design system artifact, for example an accessibility rule or a guideline that applies broadly.
Min items: 1 The same pointer type entries use. Escape hatch for tool-specific document-level data, keyed by namespace. { "schemaVersion": "0.20.0", "name": "Acme Design System", "entries": [ { "id": "acme-design-system", "kind": "system", "name": "Acme Design System", "description": "Acme's cross-platform design system.", "metadata": { "version": "1.4.0", "organization": "Acme Corp", "url": "https://design.acme.example", "license": "MIT", "platforms": [ "react", "web-component" ], "status": { "status": "stable" } }, "sections": [ { "kind": "guidelines", "for": "all", "title": "Versioning", "items": [ { "statement": "This design system follows semver; breaking token renames bump the major version.", "level": "must" } ] } ] }, { "id": "color.action.primary", "kind": "token", "name": "Action Primary", "description": "The fill color for high-emphasis interactive surfaces.", "tokenType": "color", "metadata": { "status": { "status": "stable" }, "tags": [ "color" ] } }, { "id": "dark", "kind": "theme", "name": "Dark", "description": "Inverted-luminance theme for low-light surfaces and user preference.", "colorScheme": "dark", "metadata": { "status": { "status": "stable" } }, "refs": [ { "to": "light", "rel": "extends" }, { "href": "tokens/dark.tokens.json", "rel": "file", "note": "DTCG source for this theme's token overrides - the specific tokens that differ from `light` are whichever this file redeclares." } ] }, { "id": "button", "kind": "component", "name": "Button", "description": "An interactive element that triggers an action when activated.", "metadata": { "status": { "status": "stable" } }, "refs": [ { "to": "color.action.primary", "rel": "depends-on" } ], "sections": [ { "kind": "guidelines", "for": "human", "items": [ { "statement": "Limit each surface to one primary button.", "level": "should" } ] }, { "kind": "guidelines", "for": "all", "items": [ { "level": "must", "refs": [ { "to": "shared-a11y#touch-target", "rel": "same-as" } ] } ] } ] } ], "shared": [ { "id": "shared-a11y", "name": "Shared Accessibility Rules", "description": "Cross-cutting accessibility rules, stated once and referenced from every entry they apply to.", "sections": [ { "kind": "guidelines", "for": "all", "items": [ { "id": "touch-target", "statement": "Minimum touch target 44x44px.", "level": "must" } ] } ] } ] }

combo

object · schema/common/combo.schema.yaml

Defines what an element can or cannot be paired with. Relates to traits, tokens, and entries.

The subject of what elements can or cannot be paired with. Can be a trait, token, or entry id. The elements paired with the subject.
Min items: 1 Whether the elements in items can or cannot be paired with the subject—and how strict the rule is. Why this rule holds. { "items": [ "color.surface.default", "color.surface.raised" ], "note": "Contrast is verified only against these surfaces; on any other background the label ratio is unproven." }

example

object · schema/common/example.schema.yaml

A single example, illustrating something in context.

A short heading for the example. Describes the example in detail. A visual sample of this example. Where this example lives in code. { "title": "Loading state has an accessible announcement", "description": "Renders with aria-live=\"polite\" so the loading state is announced." }

extensions

object · schema/common/extensions.schema.yaml

Escape hatch for tool data, or for an outside id that doesn't fit this schema's own id pattern.

Open map: keys are strings, values are object

{ "com.figma": { "context": "Links this entry to its source Figma component for design-file lookups.", "displayName": "Button/Primary", "nodeId": "12:4045" } }

id

string · schema/common/id.schema.yaml

Lowercase, dash-separated segments, optionally chained with dots.

Values must match ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*(\.[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*)*$. "color.action.primary"

markdown

string · schema/common/markdown.schema.yaml

Markdown content, including headings, tables, code fences, etc.

"Use for the single primary call-to-action on a surface."

ref

schema/common/ref.schema.yaml

The one pointer type. "A points to B, and this is what kind of pointer it is."

Accepts one of:

  • string (uri-reference)
  • object What kind of pointer this is, or a namespaced custom value. What this points at, inside this document's own graph. What this points at, outside this document. Such as a file, URL, or package. What the thing being pointed at does in this context. Additional info related to the connection of the two items.
"https://storybook.org/ds/button"

requirement-level

string · schema/common/requirement-level.schema.yaml

How strict a rule is, from must to must-not.

Allowed values:

  • must
  • should
  • should-not
  • must-not
  • may
"must"

showcase

schema/common/showcase.schema.yaml

A visual sample of something. Can be a media file (image or video) or a link to a live page.

What kind of media this showcase is. Where the showcase lives. Alt text describing the image or video, for accessibility Provides additional detail about the showcase if needed. { "kind": "image", "url": "https://cdn.example.com/screenshots/button-primary.png", "alt": "Primary button in its default state, showing the filled blue background and white label.", "note": "Captured from the Storybook build, light theme." }

since

string · schema/common/since.schema.yaml

The version something was introduced in.

"1.4.0"

component

schema/entries/component.schema.yaml

A reusable UI element, like a button or a dialog.

Marks this entry as a component. One entry per platform's source file.
Min items: 1 One entry per platform.
Min items: 1 The component's variants and states.
Min items: 1 Define which of this component's own boolean traits or enum values can or cannot be paired with each other.
Min items: 1 { "id": "button", "kind": "component", "name": "Button", "description": "An interactive element that triggers an action when activated.", "metadata": { "status": { "status": "stable" }, "since": "1.4.0", "updated": { "date": "2026-06-02T00:00:00.000Z" }, "tags": [ "actions", "button", "cta", "form-control" ], "aliases": [ "btn" ] }, "refs": [ { "to": "button-group", "rel": "part-of" }, { "to": "icon-button", "rel": "alternative-to" }, { "to": "link", "rel": "alternative-to" }, { "to": "color.action.primary", "rel": "depends-on" }, { "href": "https://github.com/org/ds/react/button", "rel": "source" }, { "href": "https://storybook.org/ds/button", "rel": "storybook", "role": "hosted docs" }, { "href": "./stories/button.stories.tsx", "rel": "storybook", "role": "CSF story source", "note": "Component Story Format (CSF3) - the source the hosted docs above are built from." }, { "href": "npm:@org/ds-react", "rel": "package" } ], "traits": [ { "kind": "boolean", "id": "loading", "description": "Shows a spinner in place of the label and blocks interaction while active.", "purpose": "Prevents duplicate submissions while an action is in flight." }, { "kind": "enum", "id": "size", "description": "Controls the button's overall scale.", "values": [ { "id": "small", "description": "Compact size for dense layouts (e.g. toolbars)." }, { "id": "medium", "description": "The default size for most surfaces." }, { "id": "large", "description": "Larger touch target for primary calls-to-action." } ] }, { "kind": "enum", "id": "variant", "description": "Which visual style to render.", "values": [ { "id": "primary", "description": "The default, high-emphasis style for the main action on a surface." }, { "id": "secondary", "description": "Lower-emphasis alternative for secondary actions alongside a primary button." }, { "id": "danger", "description": "Destructive actions only (delete, revoke access, etc.)." } ] }, { "kind": "boolean", "id": "hover", "description": "Background darkens slightly when the pointer is over the button." }, { "kind": "boolean", "id": "disabled", "description": "Dimmed and non-interactive; triggered by the `disabled` prop." } ], "combos": [ { "subject": "loading", "level": "must-not", "items": [ "disabled" ], "note": "A control can't be simultaneously loading and disabled - loading already blocks interaction, and layering both muddles what the button will do when the work finishes." }, { "subject": "size.small", "level": "must-not", "items": [ "variant.danger" ], "note": "Destructive actions need the full-size touch target; a small danger button invites mis-taps on the most costly action." } ], "sourceFiles": [ { "platform": "react", "file": "./src/Button.tsx" } ], "sections": [ { "kind": "definitions", "for": "all", "items": [ { "term": "OK", "definition": "To confirm an action." }, { "term": "Cancel", "definition": "To cancel an action." } ] }, { "kind": "steps", "for": "agent", "ordered": false, "title": "Pre-release checklist", "items": [ { "title": "Focus ring is visible in both light and dark themes." }, { "title": "Loading state announces to screen readers." }, { "title": "Works with a custom icon in the leading-icon slot.", "optional": true } ] }, { "kind": "guidelines", "for": "human", "items": [ { "statement": "Limit each surface to one primary button.", "level": "should" }, { "statement": "Use buttons only for in-page actions, never navigation.", "level": "must" }, { "level": "must", "refs": [ { "href": "https://example.atlassian.net/browse/DS-482", "rel": "external-link" } ] } ] }, { "kind": "guidelines", "for": "agent", "context": "when-to-use", "items": [ { "statement": "Do not use button when the action navigates to a new URL; use the link entry instead.", "level": "must-not", "alternatives": [ { "to": "link", "rel": "alternative-to" } ] } ] } ], "$extensions": { "com.figma": { "displayName": "Button/Primary", "nodeId": "12:4045" } } }

entry

object · schema/entries/entry.schema.yaml

The structure every entry kind shares. This schema doubles as a general-use entry that isn't explicitly defined in the schema (ex: pattern, foundation, guideline). See schema/entries/ for each kind's own closing file.

This entry's unique id in the design system graph. What kind of thing this entry is, as a real design-system artifact: one of the 5 well-known kinds, or a namespaced custom kind. The human-readable display name. A one-line statement of what this entry is or is for. Explains the entry's reason for existing. Pointers to another entry this one is similar to in usage or purpose. Pointers to another entry this one inherits from (rel: extends). This entry's other pointers to entries and outside resources, not covered by related or extends. Every documentation section for this entry.
Min items: 1 { "id": "confirmation-dialog", "kind": "entry", "name": "Confirmation Dialog", "description": "A pre-composed destructive-action confirmation, built from Dialog, Button, and Icon.", "metadata": { "status": { "status": "stable" } }, "refs": [ { "to": "dialog", "rel": "composes" }, { "to": "button", "rel": "composes" }, { "to": "icon", "rel": "composes" }, { "href": "./chunks/confirmation-dialog.tsx", "rel": "file", "role": "React implementation" } ], "sections": [ { "kind": "guidelines", "for": "all", "context": "when-to-use", "title": "When to use", "items": [ { "statement": "Confirming a destructive, hard-to-reverse action (delete, revoke access).", "level": "should" }, { "statement": "Confirming a routine save or submit action.", "level": "should-not", "refs": [ { "to": "button", "rel": "alternative-to", "note": "A routine action doesn't need an interruption; a plain button keeps the flow moving." } ] } ] } ] }

system

schema/entries/system.schema.yaml

A DSDS design system. System-level information and guidance for the design system as a whole.

Marks this entry as a design system. Facts about the design system as a whole. { "kind": "system", "metadata": {} }

theme

schema/entries/theme.schema.yaml

A defined system theme.

Marks this entry as a theme. Path to the theme's DTCG source file. Which native color-scheme setting this theme matches.
Default: "light" { "id": "dark", "kind": "theme", "name": "Dark", "description": "Inverted-luminance theme for low-light surfaces and user preference.", "colorScheme": "dark", "metadata": { "status": { "status": "stable" }, "since": "1.2.0", "tags": [ "theme" ] }, "refs": [ { "to": "light", "rel": "extends" }, { "href": "tokens/dark.tokens.json", "rel": "file", "note": "DTCG source for this theme's token overrides - the specific tokens that differ from `light` are whichever this file redeclares." } ], "sections": [ { "kind": "guidelines", "for": "human", "items": [ { "statement": "Apply via the root color-scheme attribute, never per-component overrides.", "level": "must" }, { "statement": "Respect prefers-color-scheme unless the user has set an explicit preference.", "level": "should" } ] } ] }

token

schema/entries/token.schema.yaml

A single design token, from the Design Tokens Community Group (DTCG) format.

Marks this entry as a token. This token's unique id. Path to the token's DTCG source file's token reference. The token's type, from DTCG.
Pattern: ^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$ Rules about which other tokens this one must or must never be paired with.
Min items: 1 { "id": "color.action.primary", "kind": "token", "name": "Action Primary", "description": "The fill color for high-emphasis interactive surfaces.", "tokenType": "color", "combos": [ { "subject": "{color.action.primary}", "level": "must", "items": [ "{color.surface.default}", "{color.surface.raised}" ], "note": "Contrast is verified only against these surfaces; on any other background the label ratio is unproven." } ], "metadata": { "status": { "status": "stable" }, "since": "1.0.0", "tags": [ "color", "action", "primary" ], "group": "color.action" }, "refs": [ { "to": "color.action.primary.hover", "rel": "relates-to" }, { "href": "./tokens.dtcg.json", "rel": "file", "role": "color.action.primary.*" } ], "sections": [ { "kind": "guidelines", "for": "all", "items": [ { "statement": "Use for the single primary call-to-action on a surface.", "level": "should" }, { "statement": "Do not apply to destructive actions - use color.action.danger instead.", "level": "must-not" } ] } ] }

entry-metadata

schema/metadata/entry-metadata.schema.yaml

Information about a single entry, on top of the fields every metadata object shares.

A lifecycle status, optionally scoped to one platform. The version this entry was first introduced. A group name this entry belongs to, for example "color.action" on a set of related tokens. Other names this entry is also known or searched by, like a past name or a common misspelling. A visual sample of this entry, either a media file or a link. { "status": { "deprecationNotice": "Use `icon-button` instead - this variant never got contrast-tested and is being removed in 2.0.", "note": "Still supported for legacy integrations only." }, "group": "color.action", "aliases": [ "btn" ] }

metadata

object · schema/metadata/metadata.schema.yaml

Optional information about an element.

Keywords for grouping, search, and filtering.
Min items: 1 The owning team, role, or group. Independent reviews confirming this item's documentation, each recording who confirmed it and when.
Min items: 1 Why this entry was created, and how and why to use it. When this item's documentation last changed. How this entry's documentation came to exist, and who or what wrote it. Escape hatch for tool data scoped to just this entry's metadata, keyed by namespace. { "tags": [ "actions", "button", "cta", "form-control" ], "owner": "ds@pizzapartysupertime.com", "reviewed": [ { "by": "human:ahormati", "note": "Copy and contrast ratios re-checked; no changes needed." } ], "context": "Introduced to give provide agents extra information for how to ingest/use an entry.", "updated": { "note": "Added the loading trait and its guideline." }, "origin": { "method": "authored", "author": "human", "note": "The accessibility section was reviewed by a person, unlike the rest." } }

system-metadata

schema/metadata/system-metadata.schema.yaml

Information about the design system as a whole, on top of the fields every metadata object shares.

The current version of the design system. The team or company that owns the design system. The main home page or repository for the design system. The license this design system is published under. The platforms this system ships on, for example "react" or "web-component".
Min items: 1 { "organization": "Acme Inc.", "url": "https://github.com/acme/design-system", "license": "MIT", "platforms": [ "react", "web-component", "ios" ] }

definitions

schema/sections/definitions.schema.yaml

Term definitions. Can describe content labels within components or patterns, define naming conventions, act as a glossary, or be a simple way to outline component props/APIs.

Marks this section as term-definition documentation. One entry per term.
Min items: 1 { "kind": "definitions", "for": "all", "items": [ { "term": "OK", "definition": "To confirm an action." }, { "term": "Cancel", "definition": "To cancel an action." } ] }

guidelines

schema/sections/guidelines.schema.yaml

Rules for an entry. How to use it and when it is the right choice. Each item pairs a rule with why it exists.

Marks this section as guidelines. Which kind of guidance this section holds.
Default: "how-to-use" The rules, in order.
Min items: 1 { "kind": "guidelines", "for": "human", "items": [ { "statement": "Limit each surface to one primary button.", "level": "should" }, { "statement": "Use buttons only for in-page actions, never navigation.", "level": "must" }, { "level": "must", "refs": [ { "href": "https://example.atlassian.net/browse/DS-482", "rel": "external-link" } ] } ] }

section

object · schema/sections/section.schema.yaml

A logical documentation section. Every section uses the same structure (items), no matter its kind, and is tagged with who it is for (human, agent, or all). Each sections/<kind>.schema.yaml file adds its own kind value and its own structure for items.

What kind of content section this is. Who or what this section is written for.
Default: "all" The one universal list for this section kind's own structured content. Nestable written content that can include headings. Available on every section kind regardless of items' own structure.
Min items: 1 An optional heading for the section. An optional one-line intro for the section. Escape hatch for tool data scoped to just this one section, keyed by namespace. { "kind": "definitions", "for": "human", "title": "When to use", "description": "Rules for using this component correctly.", "items": [ {} ], "freeform": [ { "title": "Install", "body": "Add the package and its peer dependencies." } ] }

steps

schema/sections/steps.schema.yaml

A series of actions/steps/tasks, like a tutorial, a migration, a pattern's interaction flow, or checklist of things to verify.

Marks this section as a stepped process or checklist. Whether entries must be done in order. Set to false for an unordered checklist.
Default: true The steps or checklist entries, in order.
Min items: 1 { "kind": "steps", "for": "agent", "ordered": false, "title": "Pre-release checklist", "items": [ { "title": "Focus ring is visible in both light and dark themes." }, { "title": "Loading state announces to screen readers." }, { "title": "Works with a custom icon in the leading-icon slot.", "optional": true } ] }

shared

object · schema/shared.schema.yaml

Reusable content other entries point at instead of restating. Not a design-system artifact in its own right.

This entry's unique id. The human-readable display name. A one-line statement of what this shared entry is for. Pointers from this entry to other things. The reusable content itself, in the same section structure an entry uses.
Min items: 1 Escape hatch for tool data or an outside id, the same structure as an entry's own $extensions. { "name": "Shared accessibility rules", "description": "Accessibility rules that apply broadly across components.", "metadata": {}, "sections": [] }
